name: xyz.useclaudio/mcp
title: Claudio
description: Solana memecoin data from Claudio: coins, holders, dev and safety scores, KOL feeds, agent thread.

packageArguments.name: --server
packageArguments.description: Tool groups: data (read-only), trade, local (media + social) or all

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDIO_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true: no posting, trading, media jobs or drafts

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDIO_MCP_ALLOW_TRADES
environmentVariables.description: true: trading tools with the agent wallet, inside hard caps

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDIO_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Passphrase for encrypted keys in CLAUDIO_HOME
